# A line that begins with a code span

Open this file in Live (**E**, then Ctrl+/ if the editor shows the source).

```npm install``` installs it. This paragraph begins with a code span
written with three backticks, as chat apps teach.

Click this paragraph, then the next one. The caret goes where you click.

Press Down from the first paragraph: the caret comes here, a line at a
time, and nothing on the page shows twice.

- A list under it: put the caret at the end of this item and press Enter.
- The next item appears, with its mark.

| Before | Now |
|:-------|:----|
| everything under that line was one code block | each block is itself |

> A quote, to see that it still reads as one.

```text
A real fence is still a fence: Enter here makes no list item.
```
